concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-paypal-best-practices]] - Braintree Pay with PayPal experience route distinguishing One-Time Checkout, sub-$40 mobile-first Vaulted Payments and Recurring Payments review-page guidance, with User Agreement presentation requirements and upstream shipping-callback qualifications
warnings: Preserve the distinction between User Agreement requirements and the article's recommendations or examples.
Keep One-Time Checkout, Vaulted Payments and Recurring Payments distinct; vaulting alone does not establish a recurring-billing engine.
Retain the Vaulted Payments recommendation only for business models with average transactions below $40 and the article's One-Time Payments recommendation for the vast majority of business models.
Treat platform and App Switch statements as 2026-09-16 snapshot evidence, not proof of current SDK compatibility, availability or enablement.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-paypal-best-practices]] - Braintree-specific PayPal experience guidance for upstream versus merchant-checkout button placement, User Agreement presentation standards, shipping callbacks and the PayPal review page
warnings: Keep this Braintree article separate from direct PayPal Orders and JavaScript SDK authority.
Do not convert recommended button placement, callbacks or conversion statements into contractual requirements or guaranteed outcomes.
The User Agreement presentation paragraph is the article's explicit requirement and must retain its PayPal-and-Venmo and equal-treatment scope.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-paypal-best-practices]] - Braintree PayPal recurring-experience route for the review page's plan information and recurring indicator, distinct from token storage, scheduled charge execution and subscription lifecycle evidence
warnings: Do not treat the recurring review page as a complete recurring-billing, consent, token, charge, retry or cancellation contract.
Keep this Braintree PayPal experience guidance distinct from direct PayPal Subscriptions and Payment Method Tokens implementations.
